XKyicoZAijVI7JWKsp2h.name: Banana Smoothie
XKyicoZAijVI7JWKsp2h.description: Bananas are great choices for making homemade smoothies. Use them as a base and add different fruits for a quick and easy blended drink.
ingredients: 1/4 cup water or milk (dairy or non-dairy)
instructions: Roughly chop banana and orange quarters then add to a blender
Top with yogurt and the water (or milk)
Turn blender on and blend until creamy and smooth
Taste then adjust with honey if needed

NoEOas8szH1lYjD696rs.name: Lasagne
NoEOas8szH1lYjD696rs.description: Lasagne are a type of pasta, possibly one of the oldest types, made of very wide, flat sheets.
ingredients: 3/4 tsp salt season to your taste [Meat Sauce]
1/4 cup flour, all purpose or plain [White Sauce (Béchamel)]
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat, then add in the onion powder and carrots and cook for 8-10 minutes, or until softened. Add in the garlic powder and sauté for about 1 minute, until fragrant. [Meat Sauce]
Add mince meat and cook while breaking it up with the end of your spoon, until browned. [Meat Sauce]
Pour in the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste and dried parsley. Mix well to combine and bring to a gentle simmer. [Meat Sauce]
Season with desired amount of salt and sugar if needed. Cover and cook for about 20-30 minutes, occasionally mixing, until the sauce has thickened slightly and meat is tender. [Meat Sauce]
Adjust salt to your taste. [Meat Sauce]
In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Remove from hot plate; add the flour and whisk for about 30 seconds, or until well blended. [Cheddar White Sauce]
Place pot back onto stove, reduce heat down to low and slowly whisk in 1 cup of the milk until well combined. [Cheddar White Sauce]

Once well blended, add the remaining milk in 1 cup increments, mixing well after each addition, until all the milk is used and sauce is free from lumps. If the sauce is too thick, add a little more milk until it turns into a nice and creamy consistency. [Cheddar White Sauce]
Increase heat to medium and continue cooking sauce while stirring occasionally until it thickens (about 6-7 minutes) and coats the back of your wooden spoon. [Cheddar White Sauce]
Add in the cheddar cheese and remove from heat. Season with salt and mix until the cheese is melted through. [Cheddar White Sauce]

Preheat oven to 350°F | 180°F or 176°C | 82°C. Spoon about 1 cup of meat sauce on the base of a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, then cover with lasagne sheets. (Trim sheets to fit over the meat if needed.) [To Assemble]
Layer with 2 cups of meat sauce (or enough to cover pasta), 1 cup of white sauce and half of the cheddar cheese. Repeat layers (leaving the remaining cheese for the top). [To Assemble]
Pour the remaining meat sauce and white sauce over the last layer of lasagne sheets and top with the remaining Cheddar cheese. [To Assemble]
Bake for 25 minutes or until golden and bubbling. [To Assemble]
Garnish with parsley and let stand for about 10 minutes before slicing and serving. [To Assemble]
